title: The Anti-Arithmetic Product of Symmetric Functions
summary: The \emph{arithmetic product} $\boxdot$ is a bilinear operation on the ring of symmetric functions over $\mathbb Q$ defined by \[ p_\lambda \ \boxdot\ p_\mu = \prod_{i,j}p_{\operatorname{lcm}(\lambda_i,\mu_j)}^{\gcd(\lambda_i,\mu_j)} \] on the power-sum basis $(p_\lambda)$. It is known that this operation preserves the subring $\mathbf{Symm}_{\mathbb Z}$ of symmetric functions with integer coefficients, and is Schur-positive on pairs of Schur functions.
